intro.label: Who we are
intro.title: An industrial producer and exporter of premium charcoal and pyrolysis by-products.

items.label: Industrial production
items.text: We produce premium charcoal and by-products such as pyroligneous acid and charcoal briquettes for metallurgical, industrial and agricultural uses and premium BBQ markets.

items.label: Responsible sourcing
items.text: We work only with legally obtained forest residue and biomass from areas designated for land-use change. We avoid open burning of biomass and create value from residue.

items.label: Based in
items.text: Santa Cruz de la Sierra, Bolivia. Developed with Grupo Zwald S.R.L., which provides operating know-how, technology and commercial channels.
